title: Preview: Daddy Long Legs – Brooklyn Trio live at The Louisiana (18th February)
content:
Brooklyn trio, Daddy Long Legs stroll into The Louisana, for a headline tour following the release of their new album Lowdown Ways; a new direction from their first two studio albums (released by Norton Records) which sees the boys widen their sonic horizons with field hollers, gospel, Cajun, and Mississippi Hill Music, coupled with their renowned supercharged, harp-driven R&B bangers.

Dressed like riverboat Dandies their sound is made for the delta and is bound to bring the house down. 

Daddy Long Legs appear at The Louisiana on Tuesday 18th February Get tickets here.
